name: Backlog CLI: Graph-Based Item Backlog Management
description: Graph-backed backlog management system with 34 CLI commands for CRUD, query, lifecycle management, multi-agent coordination, and markdown interop. CLI, MCP server, and HTTP server all mounted live via apigen — no code generation.
receipts: entrypoint/backlog/src/store/*.ts (17 store files: crud, claim, lifecycle, structure, query, audit-log, ids, mapping)
signature_note: SQLite-backed graph store with bi-temporal history, audit-log event system, FTS5 dedupe/query, concurrency-safe lock-free CAS for 20-worker race-free id allocation, atomic file-lock-protected published-state cache. 3 transports (CLI, HTTP/Fastify+OpenAPI, MCP stdio) mounted live via apigen extract()->composeSchemas()->plugin.run() — no codegen. UPSERT import-from-markdown with ownership-gated cross-file updates. Eager-open avoidance: lazy store activation only on first real command.

name: Backlog HTTP Server (Fastify + OpenAPI)
description: Live HTTP server mounting all 34 backlog operations as Fastify POST routes with OpenAPI plugin. Port configurable via --port flag. Host configurable via --host flag. Transport: 'http' or 'both'.
signature_note: Live apigen mount: Fastify HTTP server with OpenAPI plugin, lazy $ref dereferencing (BUG-APIGEN-RUNMODE-REF-UNRESOLVABLE-001 workaround), test-silent logger for VITEST environments.

name: Backlog MCP Server (stdio)
description: Live MCP server exposing all 34 backlog operations as MCP tools via stdio transport. Intended for .mcp.json consumption by Claude Desktop or other MCP hosts.
signature_note: MCP tool names derived from apigen naming: backlog_<kebab-op-name>. Test fixture proves stdio MCP lifecycle against real built dist/index.js.

name: Backlog Migration System (Phase-3 Active)
description: 5-phase migration framework for transitioning from hand-edited BACKLOG.md markdown to graph-authoritative backlog management. Currently at Phase-3: graph is authoritative, CLI/MCP is the write path, BACKLOG.md is a generated projection.
signature_note: 5-phase migration (not-started→complete) with per-phase tool-authoritative semantics, global config persistence via writeMigrationPhase, installable agent skill for MCP tool discovery, parity-check projection verify gate.

name: Backlog Graph Store (SQLite + SOX)
description: SQLite-backed graph store using @adhd/sox-graph-store for nodes, edges, FTS5 search, bi-temporal invalidation. Supports 20-worker concurrent CAS, audit-log event nodes, dependency graph traversal, plan-scoped projections.
signature_note: Concurrent id allocation with CAS (resolve+insert inside .immediate() transaction), bounded jittered exponential backoff for SQLITE_BUSY, audit-log event nodes immune to metadata replace, FTS5 sanitize with Unicode-aware allowlist, content-immutability fix for FTS re-sync on edit.

name: Build Tooling: Custom Nx Executors (@adhd/nx-build, @adhd/nx-deps, @adhd/nx-assets, @adhd/nx-test, @adhd/nx-secret-scan)
description: 5 custom Nx plugins with 10+ executors: version (cache-driven bump decision with published-state.json), publish (cache-check before npm publish, write-through on success), reconcile (integrity-gated npm cache backfill), manifest (dist package.json generation), verify-dist-load (dist entry load verification), hygiene (npm-pack allowlist gate), sync-deps (dependency range reconciliation), sync-deps-check, assets-copy (README/CHANGELOG to dist), secret-scan (credential detection).
signature_note: Published-state cache: zero-network version bump decision (1166× faster than tarball-fetch), normalizedHash equivalence-proof suite, atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL lockfile for concurrent-safe parallel nx run-many writes, integrity-gated reconcile (metadata compare before tarball pull), CPU-usage guard in withMetrics, vitest thread-pool bounding for CPU oversubscription prevention.

name: Vite Externalize Plugin (externalize.mjs)
description: Vite/rollup plugin computing build-time externalization lists from real dependency trees. Externalizes only non-@adhd/* deps and Node builtins; @adhd/* workspace packages stay bundled to work around @adhd's no-workspace-linking architecture. Used by >30 vite.config.ts files.
signature_note: Resolves the full transitive @adhd/* dependency tree via computeRealDependencyNames. Critical for all packages — without it, bundled @adhd/* imports break at runtime.

name: Published-State Cache (published-state.json)
description: Committed cache of 54 published npm packages with {version, normalizedHash, publishedIntegrity}. Provides zero-network version-bump decisions and existence checks. Concurrency-safe via atomic file lock.
signature_note: normalizedHash proven equivalent to full per-file tarball diff (compare-published.spec.mjs includes both-direction equivalence proof + range-move-but-hash-equal + code-change-hash-different cases).

name: Metrics Framework (withMetrics + CPU Guard)
description: Centralized per-task-run performance recording for all custom Nx executors. Records wall time, named sub-phase timings, subprocess spawn count+ms per command, network call count, and CPU% usage. Includes CPU-usage guard that fails tasks exceeding ADHD_NX_METRICS_MAX_CPU_PCT (default 300%).
verified_output:
ℹ tests 38
ℹ pass 38
ℹ fail 0
signature_note: Instrumented across 10+ executors with zero boilerplate per-executor; concurrency-safe append via atomic lockfile with stale-lock recovery; bounded log growth (5000 records). CPU guard runs independently of recording (ADHD_NX_METRICS=0 disables recording while guard stays active).

name: Agent MCP Server
description: MCP server enabling LLMs to spawn, delegate to, and coordinate AI agents across multiple providers (Claude, LM Studio, etc.) with session/task/prompt/tool persistence, DAG task dispatch, human-in-the-loop, usage budgeting, and policy enforcement.
signature_note: SSE port contention fixed (per-instance port derivation via @adhd/environment), import-time DB side effects removed via @adhd/agent-core-env, registry DB default moved to ~/.adhd/agent-registry/ (no repo-root data/), MCP protocol via stdio/SSE/streaming HTTP.

name: Agent Registry Environment Resolver
description: Shared @adhd/environment-backed resolver for the agent-registry family's single SQLite database. Replaces import-time DB opens with lazy DI pattern. Exports resolveRegistryDbPath, openRegistryDb, agentRegistryEnvironmentSpec.
signature_note: Eliminates import-time side effect (DB open at module load), switches registry family to lazy environment-based resolution, unifies DB path discovery for prompts/tools/policy/provider stores. Published to npm as @adhd/agent-core-env@0.0.4.

name: Apigen CLI: Code-First API Generation
description: CLI tool: write plain TypeScript functions, apigen extracts a transport-neutral operation descriptor and projects to 8+ transports: Fastify HTTP, Express HTTP, MCP tools (stdio/SSE/streaming HTTP), CLI (Commander), JSON Schema, OpenAPI 3.x, Python Flask, Python gRPC.
signature_note: Schema extraction via ts-morph + ts-json-schema-generator, live run() path for all 4 run-capable plugins (cli-output now included), canonical route/tool-name projection (kebab HTTP paths, qualified MCP tool names), configurable namespace per source (dropFileSegment), native CLI passthrough (apigen run --type cli -- <command> <args>), SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP killability with orphan-guard for child processes.

name: Apigen Plugin System
description: Transport plugins projecting the same operation descriptor to multiple endpoints: MCP, Fastify HTTP, Express HTTP, CLI (Commander), JSON Schema, OpenAPI 3.x, Python Flask, Python gRPC. All 10 plugins support generate(); 5 support live run().
signature_note: cli-output now also run-capable (live dispatch, not just generate). canonical route/tool-name projection across all transports. Deduplicate runExtractorEmitJson into apigen-python-env. Ephemeral ports for py-flask/py-grpc test servers. EnvelopeCapability wired into --use schema composition. Operations now threaded through PluginInput. Consistent kebab-case HTTP routes, qualified MCP tool names.

name: Apigen Serve: Multi-Host Front Proxy
description: Multi-source multi-language HTTP/gRPC front proxy. Mounts many apigen-powered services behind one port with path-based routing to the owning child. Routes are canonically kebab-cased; front proxy is path-preserving. Supports namespace collision detection (canonical-form).
signature_note: Front proxy routes by URL segment to owning child (kebab-keyed lookup for HTTP, raw-keyed for gRPC), HTTP namespace segment mirrors toKebab(makeSeg(ns)), canonical-collision detection for differently-cased namespaces that kebab to the same wire segment.

name: Apigen Canonical Route/Tool-Name Projection
description: Consistent canonical route/tool-name projection across all transports: kebab-case HTTP paths, qualified project(op).mcp.name MCP tool names, nested kebab CLI paths with namespace prefix. Configurable dropFileSegment per source.
signature_note: Fix for BUG-APIGEN-OPENAPI-ROUTE-PATH-MISMATCH-001 / BUG-BACKLOG-MCP-TOOLNAME-CLIENTD-LEAK-001. Fixes phantom import specifier BUG-APIGEN-NAMING-IMPORT-SPECIFIER-DIVERGENCE-001 (37 files).

name: Dispatch: DAG Task Orchestration Library
description: Library for validating task DAGs, generating cost snapshots, optimizing execution paths, and running dispatch cycles with milestone tracking. Exports validate, snapshot, optimize, eligible, status, run, calibrate as functions. CLI deployable via apigen generate-cli or hand-written bin/cli.ts fallback (neither dist-built by default).
receipts: entrypoint/dispatch-cli/package.json (v0.0.4, no bin field — library entrypoints only)
signature_note: DAG validation with cycle detection, cost-per-milestone snapshot generation, route optimization (topo sort + cost minimization), live dispatch with cancellation and error recovery. API surface consumable both as a library and as a CLI (apigen-generated or hand-written Commander wrapper).

name: Environment: Zero-Config Cascade
description: Cascading configuration system: code defaults → system (/etc/adhd) → global (~/.adhd) → project (.adhd/) → local overrides → env vars. Fully optional, no files required, pure TypeScript, safe for Node and browser.
signature_note: Cascade resolution with type-safe config, advisory locking for multi-instance collision avoidance, snapshot persistence for cross-process state sharing, scope auto-detection (project vs global), remappable env var prefix. Consumers: agent-mcp, apigen-plugin-mcp, backlog, all registry-family packages.

name: Agent Registry Family (12 Packages)
description: 12-package ecosystem for agent execution: base types, policy engine, provider registry, session/task/prompt/tool stores, orchestration engine, plugins (budget capping, output sanitization), generator, and env resolver. All published to npm.
signature_note: Import-time DB side effects eliminated (agent-core-env), share SQLite via environment-backed resolver, policy enforcement with rate limiting, provider adapter pattern (Claude, LM Studio), Nx generator for scaffold conformance. All 12 published to npm.

name: Workspace Codegen Nx Generator
description: Mandatory package scaffolding generator. Creates tier-correct packages with proper naming (domain-tier-name), tagging (domain/pkg-kind/layer/platform/access), and architectural boundary enforcement. 9 tier templates (types/base/core/engine/store/plugin/generator/query/entrypoint).
signature_note: Generator enforces tier/domain/platform/layer/access tags, emits correct project.json structure, prevents upward dependencies and platform isolation violations.

name: Data Utilities: Transforms + Query Engine
description: Shared data packages: @adhd/data-base-transforms (camelCase, deepCopy, deepEqual), @adhd/data-core-structures (set operations), @adhd/data-query-engine (JSON query engine). Tier: core. Domain: data. platform:shared.
signature_note: platform:shared — safe in Node and browser. data-base-transforms is the most-imported package in the monorepo.

name: MCP Shell Server (tools/mcp-shell)
description: Runtime MCP stdio server that exposes a restricted shell command execution tool (run_command). Commands restricted to an allowlist (npx, npm, node, ls, cat, git, etc.). Security-gated via ALLOWED_DIR and ALLOWED_COMMAND_PREFIXES. NOT an Nx plugin — standalone runtime utility.
signature_note: Security-first MCP tool: allowlist of safe commands, disallowed patterns (rm, sudo, curl, etc.), restricted directory scope enforced. Self-contained single-file server with no external deps.

name: Release Commit Automation (pnpm release:commit)
description: Opt-in release commit automation: stages + commits exactly the bumped package.json, CHANGELOG.md, and published-state.json update together. Explicit pathspecs only — never git add -A. Available as pnpm release:commit and pnpm release:commit:dry.
signature_note: Deliberately opt-in, never run automatically by pnpm release. Closes DEBT-BUILD-VERSION-NO-AUTOCOMMIT-001.

name: Vitest Thread-Pool CPU Bounding (DEBT-TEST-CPU-OVERSUBSCRIBED-001)
description: Prevents multiplicative CPU oversubscription from N concurrent vitest processes. Shared vitest-pool-defaults.mjs clamps maxThreads to clamp(ceil(cores/3), 2, 4), wired into 45 previously-unbounded vite.config.ts files.
signature_note: Resolved by measuring real CPU before/after (207% avg → bounded). Residual single-suite spike is concurrency-scale.spec.ts by design.

name: Legacy Backlog Util (tools/util/backlog.mjs)
description: Standalone CLI tool for parsing and querying BACKLOG.md markdown. Superseded by @adhd/backlog (entrypoint/backlog) and the Phase-3 graph-authoritative migration. Retained for backward compatibility and reference.

name: Environment CLI (in development)
description: Planned CLI for environment configuration management: init, build, set, status, export commands. Stub directory exists at entrypoint/environment-cli/.
verified_output: ls: entrypoint/environment-cli/dist/index.js: No such file or directory

name: Agent Usage Accounting: Task/Session/Agent Usage Tracking
description: Per-task, per-session, and per-agent usage tracking in agent-mcp. Captures input/output tokens, model calls, wall-clock time, model processing time, cost, tool calls, and response size across all providers. Usage data persisted to SQLite and queryable via usage_query tool.
signature_note: Usage plugin wires into agent lifecycle hooks (pre:model_request, post:model_response, post:tool_call). Records to SQLite grain fields (inputTokens, outputTokens, modelMs, cost, toolCalls). Queryable via usage_query MCP tool with task/session/agent/time-range filters. Persisted across restarts via store-runtime schema.

name: Agent Budget Enforcement: @adhd/agent-plugin-budget
description: Caps token spend, cost, wall-clock time, model calls, tool calls, and response size per task, session, agent, or globally. Supports ISO 8601 duration windows. Warning vs block enforcement modes. Backward-compatible flat config fields (maxInputTokens, maxCost, etc.) automatically mapped to structured cap schema.
signature_note: Fields: tokens, inputTokens, outputTokens, calls, wallClock, modelMs, cost, toolCalls, responseSize. Scopes: task, session, agent, global. Modes: warning (log + warn header), block (IEnforcementError throws). ISO 8601 duration parsing for rolling windows. Published to npm at @adhd/agent-plugin-budget@0.0.6.

name: Claude CLI Provider: Local claude Subprocess Provider
description: Provider type 'claudecli' that uses the local claude CLI (Claude Code) as a subprocess provider. Supports configurable claudePath, allowedBuiltinTools whitelist, and systemPromptIsAgentSpec mode (treats system prompt as complete Claude Code agent markdown file with YAML frontmatter). Reuses any auth method already configured in Claude Code (subscription, API key, OAuth).
signature_note: All Claude Code built-in tools disallowed by default — only MCP tools from mcpServers available. Selectively re-enable specific built-ins via allowedBuiltinTools array. systemPromptIsAgentSpec mode writes prompt to temp dir and uses --add-dir/--agent instead of --system-prompt/--disallowedTools.

name: Agent Rate Cards: Provider Pricing Configuration
description: Rate card definitions for provider pricing. Maps provider type + model to per-unit costs (input token, output token, etc.). Used by usage accounting to compute monetary cost from token counts. Rate cards published as part of @adhd/agent-core-provider.
signature_note: Rate cards enable cost computation from usage accounting data. Part of the broader agent-mcp usage accounting system.

name: Backlog Install-Skill: One-Command Skill Installation
description: Install the @adhd/backlog MCP usage skill to any supported host (claude, codex, opencode) in one command. Copies the packaged skill/SKILL.md to the correct skill directory per host. Supports --host (default: all) and --scope (user/project). Zero external dependencies — no soxe or installer CLI needed.
signature_note: Special-cased in cli.ts before apigen dispatch — no store/ctx needed. Supports claude (.claude/skills/), codex (.codex/skills/ with CODEX_HOME override), and opencode (~/.config/opencode/skills/). Skill file versioned in lockstep with client.ts in the same publish.

name: Apigen Base: Error Types & Helpers
description: Core error types for the apigen ecosystem: ApiError class with typed error codes, HTTP status mapping, and isApiError() duck-type guard (cross-bundle-safe instanceof replacement). Zero dependencies.
signature_note: Zero-dependency base package. ApiError with code (string), message, statusCode, details. isApiError() uses duck-typing (ERROR_CODES includes check) so it works across Vite bundle boundaries where instanceof breaks. HTTP_STATUS maps ApiErrorCode to HTTP status codes.

name: Apigen Base: Logical Type System
description: Logical type codec registry and contracts for the apigen ecosystem. Supports Decimal, int64, date-time, byte, uuid, and other logical types that extend JSON Schema. Envelope-based encoding for schema-less positions. Zero dependencies.
signature_note: Zero-dependency base package. Provides LogicalTypeRegistry interface, createRegistry, ENVELOPE_KEY, CodecRegistryError. Used by apigen-cli and all transport plugins to encode/decode logical types across the wire.

name: Apigen Base: JSON Schema Utilities
description: JSON Schema type definitions and utilities for the apigen ecosystem: ApigenSchema interface, isJsonSchema type guard, requiredFields extraction, schemaType detection, and JSON Schema draft-07 compatibility helpers.
signature_note: Used internally by apigen-core-client for schema manipulation and by conformance testing.

name: Apigen Base: Shared Type Definitions
description: Shared TypeScript type definitions for the apigen ecosystem. Re-exported from a generated barrel file. Zero dependencies.
signature_note: Minimal barrel package. Zero dependencies. Provides type contracts shared across apigen packages.

name: Apigen Codegen: OpenAPI 3.x Generator
description: Code generation plugin for OpenAPI 3.x specification output. Takes an apigen operation descriptor and produces an OpenAPI 3.x spec document with paths, schemas, and parameters.
signature_note: One of the 8 transport plugins. Supports generate() only (not live run()). Outputs valid OpenAPI 3.x with canonical kebab-case paths.

name: Apigen Engine: Conformance Testing Framework
description: Cross-host conformance testing framework for apigen transport plugins. Drives real servers and compares raw responses for byte-identical wire format across transports.
signature_note: Powers the cross-host response envelope conformance gate that ensures TS Fastify and Python Flask servers produce byte-identical canonical JSON wire.

name: Apigen Engine: Plugin Gateway & Dispatch
description: Plugin gateway and dispatch routing for the apigen runtime. Handles cross-plugin dispatch, middleware composition, deadline propagation, and error routing for multi-transport setups.
signature_note: Updated alongside the serve-core refactor with isGatewayError duck-type guard for cross-bundle ApiError safety.

name: Apigen Engine: Runtime (Invoke, Validate, Dispatch)
description: Core runtime for apigen: createInvoker for composed middleware stacks, validate-Layer for schema-based input validation, dispatchForPlan for operation dispatch, EventBus for lifecycle events, TransportAdapter and OpPlan primitives for the serve-core refactor.
signature_note: The most-imported apigen engine package. Powers all 4 run-capable transport plugins. OpPlan + TransportAdapter primitives enable the serve-core refactoring. validate-Layer provides ajv-based schema validation with custom format support (decimal, int64, date-time).

name: Apigen Generator: Nx Plugin/Host Generator
description: Nx code generator for scaffolding apigen transport plugins and hosts. Generates the project.json, vite.config.ts, plugin boilerplate, and test harness for new apigen plugin packages.
signature_note: Supports two generator types: plugin (new transport plugin package) and host (new apigen host/entrypoint). Similar to workspace-codegen-nx but specific to the apigen sub-ecosystem.

name: Apigen Python: Managed Venv Bootstrapper
description: Python host provisioning for apigen py-flask and py-grpc plugins. Resolves the Python interpreter by bootstrapping a managed venv from apigen-python's own pyproject.toml extras. Handles interpreter discovery, dependency installation, and venv lifecycle.
signature_note: Deduplicates runExtractorEmitJson into this package. Provides the Python environment layer for both py-flask and py-grpc transport plugins.

name: Decompile CLI: AI-Assisted Decompilation
description: CLI tool for AI-assisted code decompilation and analysis. Uses agent-mcp infrastructure for LLM-powered reverse engineering tasks.
signature_note: Entrypoint package (platform:node). Uses agent-mcp's agent orchestration for decompilation workflows.
